descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Platform Engineer with deep expertise in Kubernetes, container networking, and cloud-native platform operations. The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-grade environments, with specialized knowledge in advanced networking technologies including Cilium, eBPF, and Isovalent Enterprise for Cilium.
 This role will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable, secure, and highly available container platforms that support critical business applications while driving automation, reliability, and operational excellence.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, deploy, administer, and optimize enterprise container platforms across development, testing, and production environments.
Manage and support Kubernetes clusters with a focus on high availability, scalability, performance, and security.
Implement and troubleshoot container networking solutions, including Kubernetes CNI frameworks and OVN-Kubernetes architectures.
Design, configure, and maintain advanced networking, network policies, service connectivity, and ingress/egress controls.
Deploy, configure, and support Cilium and Isovalent Enterprise for Cilium to enable secure, observable, and scalable Kubernetes networking.
Leverage eBPF technologies to enhance networking, security, observability, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Develop automation solutions for platform provisioning, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
Partner with application, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform stability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Monitor platform health, capacity, and performance while identifying opportunities for optimization.
Implement and maintain security best practices across Kubernetes environments.
Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, and container-related issues in production environments.
Create technical documentation, operational procedures, and architectural standards.
 Required Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience managing Kubernetes-based container platforms.
Strong hands-on experience with platform administration and engineering.
Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, components, and cluster operations.
Extensive knowledge of Kubernetes networking concepts and container networking interfaces (CNI).
Experience with OVN-Kubernetes, network policies, ingress controllers, and service mesh technologies.
Hands-on experience implementing and supporting Cilium networking solutions.
Strong understanding of eBPF architecture, use cases, and operational deployment.
Experience with Isovalent Enterprise for Cilium in enterprise Kubernetes environments.
Knowledge of Linux operating systems, system administration, and troubleshooting.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation tools).
Strong understanding of cloud-native technologies and container ecosystem tools.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Administration or Development certifications.
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).
Experience with GitOps practices and tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Knowledge of observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and OpenTelemetry.
Experience integrating Kubernetes platforms with enterprise security solutions.
Experience supporting hybrid cloud and multi-cloud Kubernetes environments.
 For more information – please apply for this job or send your CV directly to cristiana@cavendishprofessionals.com
